facts.claim: AIDANova (AIDA Cruises): Entered service 2018; 183,858 GT; 5230 guests (lower berth / double occupancy); 362 m length; Helios class.
AIDAnova is a cruise ship built by Meyer Werft GmbH in Papenburg, Germany under contract from Carnival Corporation for AIDA Cruises.

catalogSpecs.description: Helios-class LNG ship; first of AIDA’s large Helios sisters (approx. 183,858 GT).
